watchtowerDiscoverRadius.doc: Cells a claimed Watchtower discovers round it — a shrine's lantern, held higher.

sight.doc: How far a tall thing is SIGHTED past the fog: a dim silhouette while a revealed cell lies within this many cells of it. A lair's own is on the lair, in the map.

mountainBySize.doc: A mountain's sight by its block: 1×1, 2×2, 3×3. 0 is never sighted.

landmark.doc: A shrine, a ring of stones, a leyspring.

watchtower.doc: The Watchtower: a tower, seen from further.

basePerHour.doc: The drip: Knowledge an hour while the bar is under its cap. Fixed for the whole game.

cap.doc: The bar. The drip stops while the kingdom holds this much or more; lumps and purchases land over it.

landmarkClaimLump.doc: Knowledge a landmark pays once, when it is claimed.

conquestFirstClearLump.doc: What Conquest adds to every lair's first-clear lump.

goldPriceBase.doc: Gold for the first point of Knowledge bought; the nth point ever bought costs this times n to the exponent, never reset.

goldPriceExponent.doc: How steeply the Gold price climbs: the nth point ever bought costs the base times n to this. 1 is a straight line; 2 makes the tenth point a hundred times the first.

gemsPerPoint.doc: Gems for one point of Knowledge. Never rises.

perDay.doc: Raids a standing lair makes each local day, one in each equal slice of the window.

windowStartHour.doc: The local hour the raid window opens: raids land in the hours the player plays.

windowEndHour.doc: The local hour the raid window closes.

firstFightPower.doc: A lair's first fight, as a share of its power; the fights after it ramp evenly up to the full power at the last.

treasure.doc: What the people who fled left on the ground (Docs/features/01-map-and-fog.md §6.2).

everyReveals.doc: A treasure is due every this many cells the player pays to reveal, the first on the very first.

workSeconds.doc: What a treasure pays: this many seconds of the kingdom's production of its coin.

floor.doc: The least a treasure of each coin pays, whatever the production.

weights.doc: How often each coin is the treasure. Stone only once it is on the plank.

knowledge.doc: What a Knowledge treasure pays, over the bar’s cap like a lump.

firstCoin.doc: The First Morning's treasure: its coin.

firstAmount.doc: The First Morning's treasure: what it pays.

itemEvery.doc: Every this many treasures after the first, one item comes with the coin. 0: never.
